b: This leather shoe was discovered in Areni 1 cave during excavations in 2008.

Made from a single piece of cowhide leather, and still with its leather laces it has been measured as corresponding to a modern US size 7 / EU size 37 / UK size 6. It is stuffed with grass to either maintain its shape or keep the foot warm. It is unknown at this stage whether it was a man or woman's shoe.
Researchers have managed to date it back to 3600-3500 BC based on the radiocarbon dating.

The shoe managed to survive in near-perfect condition because of the cool, dry cave environment which was sealed off by several layers of sheep dung. The shoe was found upside down at the base of a shallow, rounded, and plastered pit, beneath an overturned broken Chalcolithic ceramic bowl.
